APIs and data structures for Solana epoch leader schedules.

# Purpose
Defines the public interface for Solana epoch leader schedules. It declares the `fd_epoch_leaders_t` object, which stores the epoch range, a deduplicated table of validator public keys, and a schedule of leader indexes for each rotation. The file also provides size and alignment macros, object lifecycle functions such as [`fd_epoch_leaders_new`](<#fd_epoch_leaders_new>), [`fd_epoch_leaders_join`](<#fd_epoch_leaders_join>), [`fd_epoch_leaders_leave`](<#fd_epoch_leaders_leave>), and [`fd_epoch_leaders_delete`](<#fd_epoch_leaders_delete>), and the inline lookup function [`fd_epoch_leaders_get`](<#fd_epoch_leaders_get>) for finding the leader public key for a given slot. It also defines `FD_INDETERMINATE_LEADER`, which is returned when the leader cannot be resolved because the validator is part of excluded stake.
